about: Tutorial cards: one at a time, 8 s, glass, top-left under the field note. HEAD in Chakra Petch caps, body in Plex Mono. A card with no head is a single line in caps. Every card is kept in the Field Manual (Extras). Three are fixed by the bible word for word: make, reeds, brazier.

cards.head: SALT
cards.body: what you rake is what you spend. Nothing else is money.

cards.head: ALIDADE
cards.body: hold {key:alidade} to raise it. An Instrument in the hairs shows its card.

cards.head: LAMP
cards.body: wide and steady is calm. Half shut and sweeping is wary. A pinhole is hostile.

cards.head: MAKE
cards.body: hold a quick slot to make six

cards.head: TRANSECT
cards.body: a lit line of peg-heads. Crossing it near a Plumb draws its lamp.
REEDS HIDE YOU WHILE THE WIND MOVES THEM

cards.head: STEADY
cards.body: hold {key:steady} at full draw. The hairs close for as long as the breath lasts.

cards.head: FLAGGED
cards.body: a Plumb's sightline has you. For 8 s every Instrument within 60 m knows where you are.

cards.head: TRIG PILLAR
cards.body: sight two others from the top with {key:bearing}. A closed triangle opens its sheet of the map.

cards.head: WEAK POINT
cards.body: the Alidade rings it. Two hits on a Plumb's level vial and it cannot find level.

cards.head: PRY
cards.body: while it is down, {key:pry} takes the tool off. What it carried is yours.

cards.head: BRAZIER
cards.body: rest to choose the light. Resting saves.
